text: Automation is an interdisciplinary subject that takes control theory as its core and integrates electronic technology, computer science, sensor technology and systems engineering. It aims to achieve intelligent and unmanned control of various systems, such as industrial production, transportation, energy and medical equipment. The training objective is to enable students to possess the capabilities of control system analysis and design, sensor and detection technology application, intelligent algorithm development, system integration and optimization, etc., and to be able to engage in scientific research, design, operation and maintenance, and management in fields such as intelligent manufacturing, intelligent transportation, aerospace, and new energy.
